verdict.rationale: Foreloop's feedback docs say an intention starts from a feedback report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention and proposes the tasks. Submissions route to a chosen project or to the org Feedback list, and are triaged as real or spam first, so feedback becomes actionable work directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the feedback-to-intention flow, and detail on how the PM reviews or edits the proposed tasks.
